definition_of_done: Snapshot flow can request a viewport screenshot for each step when screenshot policy is enabled.
Integration test on a harness page confirms non-empty screenshot bytes are captured for at least one step.
Quality gate passes: `cargo test`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`, and `cargo fmt --all -- --check`.

recommended.approach: Add capture at the snapshot boundary so timing and failures are attributable to one stage.

title: Capture viewport screenshot bytes in snapshot pipeline
